title: Geodesic traces in dynamical Brownian last passage percolation
summary: We consider Brownian last passage percolation (BLPP) in which the Brownian increment process on each unit horizontal interval is independently resampled at rate one. By combining strong passage-time stability estimates with a multiscale analysis of static near-optimal paths, we show that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, the union of all geodesics between two KPZ-scale rectangles of transverse width of order $n^{2/3}$ and longitudinal length of order $n$, separated by a distance of order $n$, visits at most $n^{1+\varepsilon}$ unit horizontal cells in the bulk during the critical time interval…
